versions.content: Multi Line FOR Blocks Multiline FOR blocks has the following form: FOR <name1> : <list1>; <name2> : <list2>; ... <nameN> : <listN>; <remainder> Multiline FOR blocks are syntactic sugar only and are directly equivalent to a sequence of single line FOR blocks: FOR <name1> : <list1>; FOR <name2> : <list2>; ... FOR <nameN> : <listN>; <remainder>
